From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@brightleaf.com>, Avery Collins <avery.collins@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLeaf POC kickoff recap & next steps

Hi Jordan / Avery —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from my side and the proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth heading into the pilot. Happy to update if I missed anything.

Key pain points you shared
- Inference latency spikes during peak periods (affects customer-facing search UI)
- High per-query inference cost impacting unit economics for recommendations
- Lack of deterministic routing/fallbacks when capacity is constrained

Goals for the POC (success metrics)
- Reduce per-query inference cost by >= 30% compared to current baseline
- 95th percentile latency <= 300ms for the production prompt set at expected load
- Maintain or improve precision on the provided evaluation prompt set (A/B vs current model)

Proposed POC scope (2 weeks)
- Environment: Redwood Hosted + Dedicated fallback for peak load testing
- Workloads: 5k representative prompts (we asked for the subset you flagged) + live shadow traffic for up to 48 hours
- Deliverables: setup guide, evaluation report with latency/cost/quality metrics, recommended config (batching / quantization)

Owners
- Customer lead: Jordan Lee (BrightLeaf) — data & schemas, acceptance
- Redwood PM: Marissa Cole — overall POC coordination, success criteria
- Redwood SE: Rishi Malhotra — infra setup, routing, stress tests
- Redwood Solutions: Neha Kapoor — prompt set evals, quality/regression checks

Timeline & immediate next steps
1) Jordan: share the 5k prompt CSV + any rate/traffic profile by EOD Friday (2027-09-03) — REQUIRED for test plan
2) BrightLeaf: provide an AWS role or temp credentials for read-only access to the sample traffic bucket and a dedicated API key for shadow traffic (details in access_checklist.xlsx)
3) Redwood: provide SOW + access checklist (attached) and SOC2 snapshot (attached)
4) Kickoff: schedule technical kickoff for Mon 2027-09-06 (we suggested 10am PT) — confirm availability

Attachments: BrightLeaf_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW + success criteria), access_checklist.xlsx, SOC2_Snapshot_2027-08.pdf

If that lines up, I'll post a calendar invite for the kickoff and loop in any additional PMs/engineers.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
